text:
```yaml
name: NPM Publish

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: MetaMask/action-checkout-and-setup@v3
        with:
          is-high-risk-environment: false
          node-version: $(cat .node-version)
          skip-install: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: .
          useLockFile: true
          useRollingCache: true
          install-command: 'pnpm install'
          cache-key-prefix: 'pnpm'

      - name: Set npm dist-tag
        id: set-dist-tag
        run: echo "::set-output name=dist_tag::$(if [[ $GITHUB_REF == *prerelease ]]; then echo 'next'; else echo 'latest'; fi)"

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: |
          pnpm publish --access public --tag ${{ steps.set-dist-tag.outputs.dist_tag }}
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```
